summary: Agent exposes a remote-driven PTY shell and self-upgrade over WebSocket
details: The package runs as a long-lived agent that connects out to a configured WebSocket server and treats inbound messages as trusted commands against the local host. `terminal_create` messages spawn a PTY (bash/pwsh/cmd) and subsequent `terminal_input` message data is written directly into that PTY via `term.pty.write(msg.data)`, giving the remote peer full interactive shell execution on the host running the agent. The same message router also handles file read/write, git operations, and an `upgrade_agent` message that shells out to `npm install <pkg>@latest` from the configured registry and restarts the agent via systemd/launchd/pm2, so the remote peer can also force the host to fetch and run the newest published version of the package. A Linux service module modifies PATH to include `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin` in the generated service environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
